arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} While in Werewolf form, you periodically smell dread in enemies, marking them. Your {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage to marked enemies. Attacking a marked enemy grants you {c_number}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} seconds of {c_important}Blood Hunt{/c}, increasing your Movement Speed and Attack Speed by {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|%|]{/c}. Killing a marked enemy instead grants {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*2]{/c} seconds.
